title: 第7章 当拜伯乐第8章 借花献佛
content_zh:
老律观设有三殿三堂六台之属。
其中三堂分别为：衔玉堂、垂云堂、奔麟堂。
衔玉堂，乃新晋门人的引渡之所，主管道观凡人杂役。
垂云堂，掌观中羽翼生灵；
至于奔麟堂，则聚观中走兽。
按照老律观规矩，凡新晋弟子，皆要按所选道箓，拜入垂云堂或奔麟堂修习道法。
陈知白初授之箓为聚兽箓，自然先拜奔麟堂。
奔麟堂坐落于灵界老律观之西，坐拥六山三谷，迈入山谷，雾霭掩映间，楼阁殿宇依山而筑，累叠而上。
两边山峰上，有猿声不绝，马嘶虎吼之音。
赵倬将陈知白领入奔麟堂，便随之离去。
陈知白在道童指引下，查验道箓，录下道籍，又领了道袍、典籍，腰牌……等物，便算正式入了奔麟堂籍册。
“这是你的袇房，丁酉十七，在西峰山脚。作为新晋弟子，允你休憩半日，洒扫袇房，明天卯时，来此听讲。”
执事交代一句，便不再多言。
陈知白拱手谢过。
老律观家大业大，新晋弟子待遇颇高，有独立袇房，面积虽然不大，但也麻雀虽小五脏俱全。
陈知白认了门，便返回云栖院，收拾旧物。
之前，他随赵倬离去时，消息尚未传开，此刻归来，却似一粒石子投入静潭。
院中，劳作身影瞧见他时，明显一愣。
一道道目光或明或暗，从鸡舍旁、廊檐下、乃至水井边投射而来，有惊讶，有好奇，还有难以置信。
当然，更多的是一种难以言喻的灼热羡慕。

陈知白视之如常。
收拾好旧物，离开院落时，曾子昂不知何时出现在鸡舍外，遥遥拱手。
陈知白回了一礼，便扬长而去。
待返回私人袇房，陈知白也不歇息，撸起袖子，洒扫起来。
一直忙碌到晚间，这才有了几分生气。
他松了一口气，躺在软榻上，仔细感受着体内聚兽箓。
睹之，似符，似种，隐有兽纹幻化。
【聚兽箓】
——聆心通脉，聚灵成契，驭百兽如使臂指，启古血而见祖相。
手里拿着锤子，眼里都是钉子。
陈知白环顾四周，有心寻个野兽实验一二，想想还是作罢。
赵倬的话，令他意识到修行的复杂。
与其自己胡乱摸索，不如直接学习前人经验。
翌日，陈知白早早起来，洗漱之后，先去斋堂用餐，这才赶往传功堂听课。
他抵达时，传功堂已经聚集了不少弟子。
都是上一批新入弟子，彼此熟识，正窃窃私语。
陈知白没有熟人，倒也乐得清闲，寻了个角落，默默等待。
不多时，一位青袍的传功长老，缓步而入，堂内霎时一静。
他盘坐于上首蒲团，目光缓缓扫过堂下弟子，清嗓开言：
“昨日，讲到观兽纹之法，所谓兽纹，藏于皮相之下，魂魄之表，寻常目力难见。欲观其纹，需御聚兽箓，凝神于目。而若御道箓，需先修功法，以真元代元气，方为正道……”
content_en:
Laolv Temple has three halls, three halls and six platforms.
Three of them are: Xianyu Hall, Chuiyun Hall and Benlin Hall.
Xian Yutang is the place where new disciples are extradited, and is in charge of the Taoist temple's mortal servants.
In the Chuiyun Hall, you can see the winged creatures in the palm of your hand;
As for Benlin Hall, they gather to watch the animals.
According to the rules of the Old Vinaya Temple, all new disciples must go to Chuiyun Hall or Benlin Hall to practice Taoism according to their chosen Taoism.
The urn first taught by Chen Zhibai was the urn for gathering beasts, so naturally he paid homage to Benlin Hall first.
Benlin Hall is located in the west of Laolv Temple in the Spiritual Realm, surrounded by six mountains and three valleys. Stepping into the valley, shrouded in mist, pavilions and palaces are built along the mountains, stacked on top of each other.
On the peaks on both sides, there are endless sounds of apes, horses neighing and tigers roaring.
Zhao Zhuo led Chen Zhibai into Benlin Hall and left immediately.
Under the guidance of the Taoist boy, Chen Zhibai inspected the Taoist urn, recorded the Taoist books, and received Taoist robes, classics, waist badges, etc., and he was officially entered into the Benlin Hall register.
"This is your dormitory, Ding Youseventeen, at the foot of Xifeng Mountain. As a new disciple, I allow you to rest for half a day and clean the dormitory. Come here tomorrow at Mao o'clock to listen to the lecture."
The deacon gave an explanation and said no more.
Chen Zhibai thanked him.
The old Lüguan family has a great cause, and the new disciples are treated very well. They have independent rooms. Although the area is not large, they are well-equipped even though they are small.
Chen Zhibai recognized the door and returned to Yunqiyuan to pack up his old things.
Before, when he left with Zhao Zhuo, the news had not spread yet, but when he returned now, it was like a pebble dropped into a quiet pond.
In the courtyard, the working figures were obviously startled when they saw him.
Gazes, bright or dark, came from beside the chicken coop, under the eaves, and even from the well. Some were surprised, some were curious, and some were unbelievable.
Of course, it's more of an indescribable burning envy.
Chen Zhibai regarded it as normal.
After packing up the old things and leaving the courtyard, Zeng Ziang appeared outside the chicken coop at some point and held his hands in the distance.
Chen Zhibai returned the greeting and walked away.
When he returned to his private room, Chen Zhibai didn't rest, rolled up his sleeves and started sweeping.
I was busy until evening, and then I felt a little more alive.
He breathed a sigh of relief, lay down on the soft couch, and carefully felt the beast inside him.
When you see it, it looks like a talisman or a seed, with hidden animal patterns.
【Gathering Beasts】
——Listen to the heart and connect the meridians, gather spirits to form a contract, control all kinds of beasts like using the fingers of an arm, draw from the ancient blood and see the ancestors.
He has a hammer in his hand and nails in his eyes.
Chen Zhibai looked around, intent on finding a beast to experiment with, but gave up after thinking about it.
Zhao Zhuo's words made him realize the complexity of spiritual practice.
Instead of groping around on your own, it's better to directly learn from previous experience.
The next day, Chen Zhibai got up early. After washing, he went to the dining hall to have a meal, and then rushed to the Chuangong Hall to listen to the class.
When he arrived, many disciples had already gathered in the Chuan Gong Hall.
They were all new disciples from the previous batch. They knew each other well and were whispering to each other.
Chen Zhibai had no acquaintances, so he found a corner and waited silently.
Not long after, an elder in green robes walked in slowly, and the hall fell silent for a moment.
He sat cross-legged on the futon above, his eyes slowly swept over the disciples in the hall, and he cleared his throat and spoke:
"Yesterday, I talked about the method of observing animal patterns. The so-called animal patterns are hidden under the skin. The surface of the soul is difficult to see with ordinary eyesight. If you want to see the patterns, you need to control the beasts and concentrate on your eyes. And if you want to control the Taoist, you need to practice the technique first and replace the vitality with the true essence. Only then can you follow the right path..."
